note: Coral Hospitality runs the campground for the state; check in at the Lodge. The paved road up to the campground is steep: the park says the hill reaches a 25% grade at times and to use a low gear. Glamping safari tents (sites 2-6) book separately.

Website lists three URLs; the gastateparks.reserveamerica.com link is wrong for this campground (the lodge books it on https://us01.iqwebbook.com/TLAAFGA683/). Suggest https://amicalolafallslodge.com/accommodations/ plus https://gastateparks.org/AmicalolaFalls.

Booking policy: the entry inherits the state:GA row (13-month window, 4pm cutoff, weekend 2-night / holiday 3-night minimum, 14-night max), but that row's own note says the lodge parks (Amicalola Falls, Georgia Veterans, Little Ocmulgee, Unicoi) handle 'their reservations and policies' themselves, and the lodge publishes none of those rules. Consider policy_ref 'none' for booking (keeping the $10 ParkPass), as for the other lodge parks.

Road access, for the human: the Camping FAQs say 'The hill is steep. At times it can have up to a 25% grade ... Know your vehicle's towing capacity and state of repair before attempting the climb'; the park map labels it 'Paved Rd. 25% Grade'. No RV or length limit is stated, and site 1 is an RV-only paved site.
